node.control.concurrencyLimit.name: Concurrency Limit
node.control.concurrencyLimit.descriptio: Share a concurrent-session limit across this cluster for the same workflow and node. Wait in arrival order until a slot is available. On queue timeout, fail this execution or proceed beyond the limit. Forced sessions still count as active. Zero timeout waits indefinitely. Connect scope to a matching End to bound the monitored region; otherwise wait for all downstream work, including child executions. Slots are released after success, failure or cancellation. The queue shows current sessions only.
node.control.concurrencyLimit.end.name: Concurrency Limit End
node.control.concurrencyLimit.end.descri: Connect scope from one Concurrency Limit and the last work in that region. The region releases its slot after the body finishes, even on failure or cancellation. Work after End does not hold the slot.
port.description.concurrencyScope: Pairs the start and end of a concurrency region; it does not carry a normal value.
